text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B only after it had fallen far below my cost shows how strongly I resist admitting a loss; I should assess whether to hold or sell using its prospects, not the price I paid.","Doing nothing through a substantial decline did not prevent losses, so I should review my portfolio on a regular schedule and act when its risk or investment case warrants it.","I should consider the account as a whole when deciding what to buy or sell, rather than letting each stock’s gain or loss since purchase dictate my choices."]}
